name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Channel Development & Sales Operations Leader | CRM Strategy, KPI Reporting & Cross-Functional Execution
summary: Sales and marketing operations leader with 15+ years building CRM systems, channel strategy, and go-to-market execution across SaaS, agency, and B2B environments. Builds KPI reporting and dashboards that drive sales performance, translates strategy into executable roadmaps and timelines, and advises business owners and C-suite stakeholders on channel and CRM strategy. Comfortable owning multiple concurrent strategic initiatives under minimal supervision.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Architect and implement complex CRM systems in GoHighLevel (primary) and HubSpot, including contact segmentation, lifecycle stages, and data-hygiene protocols that support channel and sales strategy.

Build performance dashboards tracking lead generation, funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity, delivering insights and recommendations to executive-level stakeholders on a regular cadence.

Own the primary strategic relationship for a portfolio of service-based businesses, running discovery to surface goals, market challenges, and business opportunities, then translating strategy into executable roadmaps.
Identify strategic opportunities to expand engagement scope, recommending and scoping complementary services aligned with business objectives.
Develop full-lifecycle customer strategies spanning demand generation, CRM architecture, and customer success, demonstrating clear ROI and revenue growth.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed integrated marketing strategy across inbound, paid media, and content, acting as strategic lead and coordinating execution across internal departments and stakeholders.
Built rigorous campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations and QBRs to leadership.
Managed multi-stakeholder accounts across marketing and technology channels, translating performance data into strategic recommendations.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K-$45K, spanning health, home services, and retail verticals), retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.
Advised partners on retention strategy, customer health metrics, and automated workflows, equipping them to communicate product value to their own end customers.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance metrics to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Collaborated with Product and Engineering to route structured, high-priority partner feedback into roadmap decisions.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Directly managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years, a team of 20 and later a team of 8, overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery for a high-value client portfolio.
Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.

Drove team initiatives and process improvements for a brand-new Wix vertical that went from proof of concept to a profitable business line, contributing to hiring, onboarding, and training of new hires and developing sales training for tenured account executives.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Sold and scoped complex CRM and project-management software to agencies and professional-services firms, with deep fluency in sales enablement, contact management, and pipeline automation.
Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients, ranking which systems to change and in what order, then translated those plans into executable roadmaps for the implementation team.
Guided client onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations, building relationships with C-Suite executives as a trusted advisor on operational system design.
Ranked top three in sales on a team of 8 to 15 reps for effectively the full tenure, holding that ranking while quota roughly doubled.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate - Google / Coursera (Sept 2024)
